Class UpgradeAStationController

java.lang.Object
controller.UpgradeAStationController
public class UpgradeAStationController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing the logic of upgrading stations with buildings. Handles validation of building availability, retrieval of building types, replacement of obsolete buildings, and budget checks.

Acts as the bridge between the UI and domain services like StationUpgradeService.

    • removeObsoleteBuildings

      public void removeObsoleteBuildings(Station station, int currentYear)
      Automatically removes obsolete buildings from a station based on the current year. Specifically, removes the "Telegraph" building if the year is >= 1920, and replaces it with "Telephone" if applicable.
      Parameters:
      station - The station whose buildings are to be validated.
      currentYear - The current simulation year used to determine obsolescence.

    • getFilteredAvailableBuildingTypes

      public List<BuildingType> getFilteredAvailableBuildingTypes(Station station, int currentYear)
      Gets a filtered list of available building types for a station based on: - Current year availability - Existing buildings (to prevent duplicates) - Mutual exclusivity rules (e.g., only one hotel type allowed) - Historical constraints (e.g., Telegraph not available after 1920)
      Parameters:
      station - The station to check available buildings for.
      currentYear - The current simulation year.
      Returns:
      A filtered list of building types that can be added to the station.

    • DeductBudget

      public boolean DeductBudget(Station station, BuildingType Building, Scenario Scenario)
      Deducts the cost of a building from the scenario's budget.
      Parameters:

      Building - The building type being added.
      Scenario - The current scenario containing the budget.

    • setStationComboBox

      public void setStationComboBox()
      Populates the station combo box with available stations from the current map and scenario. Updates the hasStations flag based on whether any stations are available.

    • setBuildingComboBox

      public void setBuildingComboBox(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Updates the building combo box with available building types for the selected station. Filters buildings based on the current year and existing buildings at the station.
      Parameters:
      event - The action event that triggered this method.

    • onUpgrade

      public void onUpgrade()
      Handles the upgrade action when the user clicks the upgrade button. Validates the selection, checks budget, and adds the building if all conditions are met.

    • hasStations

      public boolean hasStations()
      Checks if there are any stations available for upgrade in the current scenario.
